status: Local development model in the working tree. Not a release: version unchanged, nothing installed, published or signed, nothing listened to. DSP only: the layer, the engine that carries it, the plug-in's routing, the tests, the offline renderer and the scores. Editor, processor and state are a colleague's work.

character.name: Undertow
character.evolution: the knob itself drives the three voice gains; at 0 the Character is Fathom at Evolution 0 to the bit
character.mix: Ocean's own linear Mix, as for Fathom; the reference's Mix law is in the offline renderer and the tests only

reference.name: Rev OCEAN
reference.recordings: five attended sessions at 48 kHz in host blocks of 512 frames: D, E, F at 120 BPM; T90 at 90 BPM with the play head 0.25 s ahead; S90 at 90 BPM with the transport stopped
reference.measuredAs: A black box, from recorded audio alone. Its binaries and files were not inspected and no session was opened for this work.

build.note: The scores were rendered before the review's two rules went in; 94 of the recordings were rendered again by the final renderer and give the same numbers.

abyssFolder.what: the campaign's own copies of the model, the findings and the session scripts, so that the generated headers can be made again from the tracked tree; the originals stay under Analyzer/Results/RevOceanCharacterization/work/abyss (not in Git), where the recordings are
abyssFolder.copiedByteForByte: everything but model/base.py, which differs from analysis3/tempo/model/base.py in where it finds the campaign and where it puts the compiled abyss_core.c and its table of oscillator states (Analyzer/Results/RevOceanCharacterization/work/abyss/model_build, ignored by Git); nothing computed differs
abyssFolder.regeneratedHeaders: byte-identical to those made from the originals apart from the comment lines that name the paths and the hash of base.py

scores.convention: null = 10 log10(sum (candidate - reference)^2 / sum reference^2) over the whole recording, both channels; no gain, delay or polarity fitted

portAgainstTheModel.limitedBy: the engine's single-precision line memory (as without the layer) and the layer's single-precision input and recirculation memory; not by the layer's interpolation, which is the model's own

engineAgainstRecordings.report: Analyzer/Results/RevOceanCharacterization/work/abyss/engine/scores.json (not in Git; every row is under "rows" here)

macroInMotion.recording: session F, part S4: sixteen steps of Macro of 20.25 s under a running tone, one render
macroInMotion.note: nulls of the whole signal; the model file is not scored here because it smooths Macro in front of its ramps

holdout.what: session_F/h1*, h2*, h3*: locked by the campaign; nothing was tuned on them; loaded once, after everything else was final

engineOwnArithmeticAgainstSessionD.note: not an error of the port: another clock of the same grid, whose chunk boundaries lie up to a millisecond or two from the reference's; only the reference's arithmetic nulls above Macro 0

dspExecutable.olderMetricLines: every [METRIC] line of the 77 older tests equals that of the build before the layer
dspExecutable.existingTestChanged: 'Fathom sample rates and stability': the mode that does not exist is undertow + 1 (it was fathom + 1); asked for by the lead

stateExecutable.owner: the colleague's file; run, not edited

tests.fathomRendererBitIdentity: nine renders with the Tide layer (44.1, 48, 96 kHz; Macro 0, 70, 100 %; with and without the outer laws) are the same bytes from the renderer of before the layer and from the final one

scenarios: a position that stands while the transport runs
a position at 90 BPM without a tempo
positionThatTellsNothing.positionAt97And103PercentOfTheTempo: followed, no reader restart, level -0.47 to -0.94 dB against a running transport
positionThatTellsNothing.oneJumpAndTwoInARow: the readers begin anew, the layer stays on the host

sanitizers.ran: AmanitaOceanDSPTests --test-undertow, built from the final sources (one comment in UndertowLayer.h was reworded afterwards)
sanitizers.notRun: the 77 older tests and the state tests

cpu.machine: one core of an Apple M4 Max, stereo, Release, 20 s of noise per figure, best of three with other work on the machine
cpu.notMeasured: the whole DSP of the plug-in in Undertow

measured: base untouched, the layer added in front of the equaliser, left and right separate
chunk lengths 4/3, 2, 8/3 quarter notes as single-precision numbers (90 and 120 BPM)
mirror law of a chunk (537 copies within 0.01 sample)
windows are fixed shares of the chunk
pre-delay, filter, Width, level stage around the layer
the position read in single precision once per host block and per converter block
a stopped transport: the layer counts by itself at the host's tempo (one session)
fitted: the voice gains and the three ramps (120 BPM)
the one-pole of 10 ms on each gain
the drift of the stopped clock (arithmetic unknown)
oceansOwn: a start, a stop and a jump of the position (more than 2 ms, or 4 % of the time since the host's last word): new start at the next internal block, 5 ms fade of a cut chunk

the tempo: every change is followed at once; a change of more than 1 % with no other change within 0.25 s, nor at the host block before or behind it, is a step and begins the readers anew once, 0.25 s behind it; changes nearer to each other are a ramp and are only followed
a position that runs more than 4 % off the tempo counts as jumping (a sum of what it strays by, with a memory of 50 ms)

a position that tells nothing: after three jumps in a row (each less than 0.25 s behind the one before, or at the next host block) the layer keeps time itself as under a stopped transport; it follows the host again once the position has run for 1 s without a jump
no tempo is 120 BPM; tempi outside 20 to 999 BPM are the nearer end
the position in double precision on the input's own time
Low Cut, High Damping, Freeze, Focus, Harmony, Mono Safe, Ocean's Mix, as in Fathom

deviationsFromTheSpecification: setLayer takes effect at the next prepare(), not at reset(): the layer's memory is allocated there

a tempo change restarts the readers only when it is a step (more than 1 %, no other change within 0.25 s); a tempo that keeps changing is followed; decided over time, so the same in host blocks of any length
a position that keeps jumping is left after three jumps in a row; the layer keeps time itself until the position has run for 1 s

a chunk takes over at its first sample or now, whichever is later (the reference's law puts some first samples one sample in front of the block that decides on them; the window is zero or within -143 dB of it there)
the plug-in's amount of the two engines together is a ramp of its own, so Fathom and Undertow crossfade with nothing of the FDN between them
limits: The octave voices hold the null against the reference near -60 dB: the reference holds the read position of its reversed readers in single precision, the model and the engine do not.
The drift of the stopped clock is not understood; it is a fitted curve from one session and holds that session's long scan at -31 dB.
One tempo besides 120 was measured (90 BPM). That a chunk is a note value at any tempo is assumed.
The Macro law was measured at 120 BPM; of the three ramps only the knee at 30 % is pinned.
One host rate was recorded: 48 kHz in blocks of 512. The golden vectors at 44.1 kHz check the port against the model, not the model against the reference.
The plug-in's own arithmetic does not null against the reference above Evolution 0: it is another clock of the same grid.
Macro acts about 54 internal samples ahead of its input at 48 kHz where the reference fits 28 to 44, and with no lead at 44.1 kHz.

A host that reports a running position without a tempo is taken at 120 BPM; if its position runs more than 4 % off that, the layer leaves the position and keeps time itself at 120 BPM: it sounds, but not on the host's grid.
A tempo step begins the readers anew 0.25 s and up to two host blocks behind the host's word of it; stairs of a tempo curve more than 0.25 s apart and larger than 1 % are steps.
The numbers of Ocean's transport rules are choices held by tests on synthetic transports; no host was tried.
The layer adds level: +1.4 dB at 30 %, +2 dB at 60 %, +3.2 to +3.4 dB at 100 % in the reference; Undertow has no trim for it.
The reference's Brightness, Transients and Ducking above 0 % have no counterpart, as in Fathom.

reviewFollowUp.what: two rules of Ocean's own in UndertowLayer.cpp after the independent code review: the tempo rule decided over time instead of by the size of one host block's change, and the fallback for a position that tells nothing

notRun: No listening test, no DAW, no plug-in validator; no plug-in bundle built or rendered here.
No build for x86_64, with GCC or MSVC, or with -ffp-contract=fast.
Sanitizers on the ten new tests only.
No recording of the reference at a host rate other than 48 kHz, at a tempo other than 90 and 120 BPM, or with a transport event under signal.
The long run is an hour of the layer keeping time and fourteen hours of position, not hours of sound.
Macro in motion was scored on one recording.
The level of Undertow against the other Characters was not measured on this build.
